title: Film your study session, face hidden — StudyReel #shorts
description:
StudyReel is a study log app for iPhone and iPad.

- Film yourself studying as a time-lapse. Your face gets a mosaic automatically
- Focus for 25 minutes, rest for 5. Filming pauses on breaks
- Trim your video, add filters and music, and style the clock
- Clear quests, earn gems, and trade them for themes and clock styles
- Watch your whole year of study fill in

Free on the App Store
https://enludus.com/products/studyreel

The study footage in this video is a sample made for the demo. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

#studywithme #studygram #studytips #pomodoro #productivity
